page.layout: One printed page: a woodcut ornament band at the top, the title in large capitals below it, a small signature mark (Y) lower on the page; no running text, no margin notes.
page.notes: The ornament band above the title is a woodcut and is not transcribed. The mark "Y" lower on the page is a printed signature-like mark, shown here as a stray sign and not transcribed as text. Printed number "I" at the top is the page number. The left edge shows cut-off marginal fragments of the neighbouring page, not transcribed. The title line "HISTORIAS NO-" ends with a printed hyphen, kept as printed.
